

```{r}
library(minotaur)
library(curatedMetagenomicData)
library(mia)
library(miaViz)
```

## Functional module analysis at gene level

```{r}
# Load gene family experiment
genes <- curatedMetagenomicData(
    "SankaranarayananK_2015.gene_families",
    dryrun = FALSE
)

# Extract experiment
genes <- genes[[1]]
```


```{r}
processGeneFamilies <- function(se){
    
    se <- se[str_detect(rownames(se), fixed("|")), ]
    se <- se[str_detect(rownames(se), "unclassified", negate = TRUE), ]
    
    splitted <- strsplit(rownames(se), "|", fixed = TRUE)
    gene.linkmap <- data.frame(do.call(rbind, splitted))
    names(gene.linkmap) <- c("GeneID", "Taxon")
    
    gene.linkmap <- gene.linkmap[gene.linkmap$Taxon != "unclassified", ]
    
    splitted <- strsplit(gene.linkmap$Taxon, ".", fixed = TRUE)
    tax.linkmap <- data.frame(do.call(rbind, splitted))
    names(tax.linkmap) <- c("Genus", "Species")
    
    tse <- TreeSummarizedExperiment(se)
    
    rowData(tse) <- cbind(rowData(se), gene.linkmap, tax.linkmap)
    
    colData(tse) <- colData(se)
    assayNames(tse) <- assayNames(se)
    
    return(tse)
}
```

```{r}
# Process experiment
genes <- processGeneFamilies(genes)

# Print experiment
genes
```

```{r}
gmm <- importModules("GMM")
gmm <- gmm[1:30]
```

```{r}
ko.uniref90 <- importMapping(
    "ChocoPhlAn",
    from = "ko",
    to = "uniref90"
)
```


```{r}
rowData(genes)$Taxon <- gsub(".", "|", rowData(genes)$Taxon, fixed = TRUE)
uniref90.tax <- split(rowData(genes)$Taxon, rowData(genes)$GeneID)
```

```{r}
modules <- mapModules(
    gmm,
    list(ko.uniref90, uniref90.tax),
    mode = "andor",
    remove.empty = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
genes <- addModules(
    genes,
    modules,
    by = 1L,
    group = "taxonomy"
)
```

```{r}
altExp(genes, "modules") <- agglomerateByModule(genes, by = 1L, group = names(gmm))
```

```{r}
plotAbundance(genes, assay.type = "gene_families")
```


## Functional module analysis at taxon level

```{r}
# Load relative abundance experiment
tse <- curatedMetagenomicData(
    pattern = "SankaranarayananK_2015.relative_abundance",
    dryrun = FALSE,
    counts = TRUE,
    rownames = "short"
)

# Extract experiment
tse <- tse[[1]]
```
```{r}
tse
```


```{r}
gmm <- importModules("GMM")
```

```{r}
ko.uniref90 <- importMapping("ChocoPhlAn", "ko", "uniref90")
```

```{r}
modules <- mapModules(
    gmm[seq(30)],
    ko.uniref90,
    type = "andor",
    mode = "taxonomy"
)
```

```{r}
tse <- addModules(tse, modules)
```


```{r}
altExp(tse, "modules") <- agglomerateByModule(tse, by = 1L, group = names(gmm)[seq(30)])

top.mods <- altExp(tse, "modules") |>
    getTop(assay.type = "relative_abundance")
```

```{r}
tse <- swapAltExp(
    tse,
    name = "modules",
    saved = "features",
    withColData = FALSE
)
```


```{r}
plotAbundance(
    tse[top.mods, ],
    assay.type = "relative_abundance",
    as.relative = TRUE,
    col.var = "disease",
    order.col.by = "disease"
)
```

```{r}
mse <- meltSE(tse, assay.type = "relative_abundance", add.col = TRUE)

ggplot(mse, aes(x = SampleID, y = FeatureID, fill = relative_abundance)) +
  geom_tile() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.x = element_blank())

```

```{r}
plotAbundanceDensity(
    tse,
    layout = "density",
    n = 5,
    assay.type = "relative_abundance",
    colour.by = "disease")
```
